title: Meta's New AI Remembers Your Chats? Here's the Catch #shorts
description:
Meta announced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full on October 12, 2026, including what Meta calls Active Memory: bringing relevant information across conversations. This is a model capability claim, NOT a live test or a feature confirmed for everyone using Meta AI today.

Muse Wonder is available for builders via the Meta Model API and Muse Code. A broader Muse personal-agent rollout is coming later, starting with subscribers. Would you enable long-term AI memory? Comment YES or NO.

Official Meta announcement: https://about.fb.com/news/2026/10/introducing-muse-wonder-models/
Technical explanation: https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-wonder

Real-world licensed stock footage: RDNE Stock project / Pexels https://www.pexels.com/video/close-up-on-man-hands-using-phone-10374885/
Animated screens are clearly labeled illustrative. #MetaAI #MuseWonder #AIMemory #AI #shorts
